status_note: The locked same-input/same-output fixture is MATCH for the targeted Action/Rule breakpoint, ordinary ActionGroup cursor, ActionPool live-tree resume/dead-cleanup, lookup, synthetic AND production derived-reset dispatch (RuleSubvarSext/RuleDoubleIn), ActionRestartGroup inherited-breakpoint child-boundary forwarding, per-Rule derived-root clone filtering, and the full raw+decompile/jumptable/register tree-name projection. The production call closure remains MISMATCH: the restart loop still lacks Architecture::clearAnalysis (PIPE-RESTART-0001), the pool state machine lacks a full-IR/order/stats corpus differential plus independent cross-review (PIPE-POOL-0001), Action::print/printState/printStatistics console projections are unported (PIPE-BREAK-0001), and PcodeOpBank::create has a pre-existing alive/dead lifecycle mismatch (OPBANK-0001).

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: ActionState and RuleState externalize Ghidra base-class fields by mutable reference; retained Group/Pool cursors and Funcdata/PcodeOp mutations survive a -1 return and are resumed in place; the two oracle Rules whose reset override omits Rule::reset keep the base warning-given bit across the pool's virtual reset dispatch.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: Groups traverse child insertion order. Pools fetch rule_index++ before skip/test/apply and dynamically reconstruct the strict successor in the live address-then-time PcodeOpTree. Derived roots traverse survivors in original registration order (Action::clone/Rule::clone group filtering); the tree projection visits Actions depth-first and pool Rules in allrules order.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: Start-break precedes Action count_tests; enabled Rule attempts increment tests once, positive results increment applies once and add the exact result; warnings precede break checks; reset preserves counts/statistics/breakpoints and resetStats alone clears statistics; ActionRestartGroup accumulates child results into its inherited count and forwards its own action-break check at each child boundary.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: PcodeOpTree order is SeqNum address followed by immutable creation time; Action/Rule lookup compares exact oracle ctor names after stripping at most one first-colon container prefix and treats ambiguity locally per level; rule survival under deriveAction compares the registration-slot basegroup string against the grouplist.

action_break_warning_resume.covers: persistent+temporary start/action bits, -1, one-time temporary clearing, warning and counter timing, status_actionbreak resume, reset/resetStats

group_cursor.covers: group-owned persistent action break advances child cursor; child negative result retains cursor; completion performs the inherited action-break check

pool_live_resume_dead.covers: retained op_state/rule_index, disabled rule, exact result count, live before/after insertion, dead entry advance-before-destroy, warning and Rule break resume

lookup_ambiguity.covers: first-colon prefix stripping, exact names, duplicate null, and locally ambiguous subtree ignored in favor of a unique immediate sibling

virtual_reset_dispatch.covers: Synthetic seam plus both production overrides: RuleSubvarSext (subflow.cc:1742-1746, reads aggressive_ext_trim, base warning-given preserved) and RuleDoubleIn (double.cc:3198-3202, sets double_precis recovery, base bit preserved) dispatched through ActionPool::reset; the locked oracle has exactly these two Rule reset overrides.

restart_group_inherited_breakpoint.covers: Child-boundary inherited action-break, resume from status_mid, and completion now match through ActionRestartGroup::apply_with_state; the restart loop itself (restart pending, jumptable guard, max-restart warning) is not yet fixture-covered and Architecture::clearAnalysis is unmodeled.

derived_root_clone_filtering.covers: Raw universal plus decompile/jumptable/register derived trees: leaf Action survival, group survival with >=1 child, per-Rule pool filtering, whole-pool omission when no Rule survives (jumptable/register drop the cleanup pool; register drops oppool2).

raw_rule_names.covers: All 76 registered Action names and all 154 Rule names in the raw universal tree match the locked oracle ctor strings byte-for-byte (116 former Rugra name drifts corrected).

pool_corpus_ir_closure.covers: The pool executor projection matches on the scripted fixture; the full-IR/order/stats differential over the E2E corpus and independent cross-review of the pool state machine remain open.

break_console_projection.covers: Breakpoint/warning/statistics executor state matches; the Action::print/printState/printStatistics console projections are not ported.

opbank_creation_lifecycle.covers: Explicit dead entries and dead-and-gone cleanup match; PcodeOpBank::create still starts new Rust ops alive instead of dead.
